caption: The drawing depicts a single, round copper pot with two curved handles attached on opposite sides near the rim. The pot is colored in shades of brown, reddish-copper, and some darker greenish and grayish areas, giving it a weathered and tarnished appearance. The handles are also colored in tones of brown and copper and are attached to the pot with rivets and metal plates that appear silver or gray. The pot sits centered on a plain off-white or beige background, and there are no other objects or additional details in the composition.
title: Copper Kettle
